summary: Prevent unadmitted shell agents from overwriting repository contents

delivery.outcome: Prevent unattended shell editing of primary, dirty or unadmitted governed workspaces; preserve preview semantics before model policy or editor fallback. Reproduce PLF031 source overwrite with a local malicious executor fixture and prove original bytes survive refusal.
nonGoals: Implement the protected controller execution adapter or authorize governed editing from local lease files
Change active ticket331 evidence attribution or ticket332 SDK latency
Repair third-party Aider parsing or restart the old production lane

architecture.decision: Use a shared read-only Git workspace guard at the Tillm execution boundary. Refuse governed writes pending controller admission, consistent with ticket330. Preview returns before execution policy/fallback and never invokes a vendor. Git checks are accident prevention, not an OS sandbox.
architecture.rollback: Revert material commit; keep unsafe lane stopped and incident snapshots intact.

validation.evidence: Real Git fixtures and local corrupting executor: primary, dirty, nested, symlink and governed targets never invoke editor or mutate original/index; clean isolated unmanaged checkout still executes.
Preview invokes no provider, policy or GUI rescue; refusal cannot trigger GUI rescue; managed gate and scoped checks.
